p=Path('programs/task-35335b5f.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=9
    # locate bounding rectangle of the contiguous zero-colored target
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==0]
    if not pts:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # recolor that solid block to color of markers that indicate it, erase markers
    marks=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,9,6,8)]
    color=marks[0] if marks else 0
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=color
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] in (4,7): out[r][c]=9
    return out
''')
